title: Williams et al. 2019 JGR Planets: Seasonal Polar Temperatures on the Moon (full-text HTML extract)
quote: We find that surfaces below 110 K capable of cold trapping water over 1 Gyr increases by factors of 2.8 and 4.3 in the winter for the south and north polar regions, respectively
quote_elevation: Limited regions of higher elevations have a low fraction of temperatures mapped below 110 K in the summer months as they experience periods of prolonged illumination.
note: Wiley programmatic GET returned 403; this extract is the 2026-09-17 full-text HTML of doi 10.1029/2019JE006028. Mons Mouton is a high point; 110 K is a printed polar cold-trap contour, not this rover sink.
